tenderSchedule.title: Office Printing service on Annual Rate Contract
tenderSchedule.description: Tender for Printing and supply of Banners, Booklet, Brochures, Forms, Invitation Cards, ID Cards Certificates, Calendar, Dairy, Badges, flags, Envelopes, Name boards & other printing works including DTP, Design work on annual rate contract basis to Kitturu Rani Channamma University, Belagavi.

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of the Registrar (Administration) Kitturu Rani Channamma University, Vidyasangama, Belagavi -591156

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer must have satisfactorily performed minimum printing Service of Value not less than 35 lakhs in a single order to any reputed state/Central Government departments/Universities/Institutions during last two Financial Years (2024-25,2025-26). Copy of Supply order and satisfactory Certificate must be enclosed

Tenderer must have provided variable data printing services to any Institutions/Universities/organisations/departments during previous two financial years. Copy of Order and satisfactory Certificate must be enclosed.
Tenderer shall be either proprietorship or partnership firm or a company registered under the companies Act
The tenderer should have a printing press in Karnataka with necessary infrastructure and personal for service support.

Tenderer Should have necessary own machineries for printing. Multi colour offset machine, Flex Printing Machine (Minimum Size 10 feet) banner printing machines and any other machines owned by the tenderer.

Tenderer must have completed at least three financial year as on 31st March 2026 (Income tax return copy, balance sheet and Profit and loss account statement of three financial years i.e,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25,2025-26)
Tenderer should have at least Two year experience in printing and supplying materials to various reputed state/Central Government departments/Universities/Institutions

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Supply Orders and Satisfactory work done certificate duly signed by the tender authority must be enclose

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderers Average Annual Turnover should not be less than of Rs.150 lakhs from preceding 3 Financial years(2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer must have valid GST registration Certificate, PAN Card (Copy of PAN and GST should be attached)
Tenderer should be solvent. Enclose National bank solvency certificate of worth Rs 30 lakhs in the name of Registrar, KRCU.

Tenderer should not have been black listed by any State or Central Government Department in India and tenderers Printing business should not be under any enquiry by court of law. Company/Firm should submit a self-declaration in this regard. Any false declaration would lead to rejection of Bids
ISO, IBC Certification is the added advantage.
Machine details owned by the Company with capacity details will be added information.
Labour Registration certificate should be attached

The tenderer must submit samples of paper quality(GSM), Banner quality, board quality. All samples shall reach the office of the Registrar, Kitturu Rani Channamma University, Belagavi on or before the last date of uploading the tender.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Invoice copy of machines in the name of tenderer with capacity details and invoice copy
